mapper.select: SELECT transfer_id, company_no, sent_date, message_no, sent_time, transfer_type_id, withdrawal_account_no, deposit_bank_code, deposit_account_no, amount, memo, response_code, balance_after, created_at FROM transfer WHERE company_no = #{companyNo} AND sent_date = #{sentDate} AND message_no = #{messageNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer (company_no, sent_date, message_no, sent_time, transfer_type_id, withdrawal_account_no, deposit_bank_code, deposit_account_no, amount, memo, response_code, balance_after) VALUES (#{companyNo}, #{sentDate}, #{messageNo}, #{sentTime}, #{transferType}, #{withdrawalAccountNo}, #{depositBankCode}, #{depositAccountNo}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{responseCode}, #{balanceAfter})
